summary: Iteration 90 — V4 Social-First Phase A+B regression. All 13 iter89 tests pass + 8 new iter90 tests pass + spot-checks on iter83/86/87/88 (12/12) pass. Frontend smoke verified: BarrioPage radius persistence works via localStorage 'barrio_radius', Contactar CTA appears on verified-provider posts, GremiosPage shows 188 cards (data-testid 'gremio-card-*') and provider detail view exposes back+Unirme+composer, Search page renders trust-tile with non-zero data-score for verified providers (demo provider scores 55).

issues: Spec asks for a 'Join' button on each gremio card in the list view, but cards currently show only 'Abrir' (open) for both anonymous and authenticated providers. The Join/Unirme action is only reachable from the detail view. Functional but a minor UX deviation from spec — providers may not realize one-click join is supported.

Non-blocking React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from the language <select> on the Filters sidebar (Search.jsx ~line 616). Emergent's dev-tooling wraps option text in a <span> with display:contents — review needed if it bleeds into production build, but no visible UI defect.

action_items: (Optional) Render an inline 'Unirme' CTA on each /comunidad/gremios list card to match the spec wording 'Join button on each'.
(Optional) Audit Search.jsx language <select> for the <option><span/></option> hydration warning — confirm it's only the Emergent dev wrapper and won't show up in production build.
critical_code_review_comments: Trust signal enrichment is computed inline in two server.py locations (lines 1641-1659 and 1669-1685 per request) plus search.py _attach_trust_signals — three call sites is fine, but consider extracting into a single util to avoid drift if the formula changes (verified=+25, portfolio_count*1.5 cap 15, reviews_count cap 20, avg_rating*4 cap 20, referrals_converted*2 cap 10, days_active/180*10 cap 10).

Backend exposes BOTH 'provider_verified' (bool) and 'verification_status' ('approved') on /providers responses — choose one canonical flag and document. Existing iter89 frontend tests look for 'provider_verified'; existing dashboards may still consult 'verification_status'.
GremiosPage shows 'Abrir' on each card whereas spec says 'Join'. Either update copy or update spec — current implementation hides one-click join behind detail view.
